purpose: Review whether the two real S28/S29 usage records from S36 and S38 are sufficient to justify domain-governance expansion.

review_inputs.surface: Dependabot/GitHub PR content and web build dependency trust boundaries

review_inputs.result: readiness gate; does not count as usage evidence

review_inputs.surface: Mission Control Adaptive Skills execution-record adapter boundary
review_inputs.result: resolved one local regression-test gap; no expansion

sufficiency_assessment.pattern_observed: Both real records used S28/S29 to keep external or cross-boundary content as evidence without granting instruction or governance authority.
heterogeneity: S36 is dependency-maintenance and CI/package-boundary review.
S38 is Mission Control adapter and web UI projection-boundary review.
sufficiency_assessment.rationale: The records show useful repeated advisory behavior, but they are not one stable comparable group and do not prove a reusable control or automation need.

observed_repeated_signals.action: keep requiring local source refs in future captures
allow future local tests only when tied to real source-backed behavior

missing_for_expansion.missing_evidence: A stable comparable group of repeated real S28/S29 usage records
missing_for_expansion.why_it_matters: Without comparable cases, AletheIA cannot infer reusable automation, metrics or success rates.

missing_for_expansion.missing_evidence: A repeated unresolved gap that cannot be handled by advisory guidance or a focused local test
missing_for_expansion.why_it_matters: No current record proves that scanners, schemas, policy engines or enforcement are necessary.

missing_for_expansion.missing_evidence: A source-backed implementation need involving auth, tenant, secrets, API state changes or rendering safety beyond the current adapter/dependency cases
missing_for_expansion.why_it_matters: S29 expansion should not be inferred from heterogeneous dependency and projection-boundary examples.

decision.rationale: S36 and S38 prove the packs are useful in real reviews, but the evidence is still too heterogeneous and too small for expansion.
decision.next_safe_step: Capture another real S28/S29 Work Slice with S35 only when S37 entry criteria are met; prefer a different source-backed web/API/auth/tenant/secrets or untrusted-content boundary if it appears naturally.
